title: Record that a G20 frame round trip does not emit
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped route obstruction on the PR #5708 word. No new κ. Selected κ stays `781451/250000000`.

The published route table has 2369 edges. Every edge drops frame dimension, and the rank equals that drop. Frame 1 is the only dimension-8 frame and has indegree 0, so a conversion and its inverse do not both emit. There is no route-legal two-query paid/target delta.

Helper 222 starts on frame 1. Events 5638 through 5643 are `ADD`s declared on frame 1. Those `ADD`s are ill-typed after any published exit, because no route returns to frame 1.

At the opening cut, each of the 413 public helpers is a one-field carrier of boundary rank 1 and internal rank 1. Frame 1 has 189 empty compatible exits, 9 of rank 1 and 180 of rank 2. The edge `(1, 517, 1)` creates that singleton channel and then leaves the six `ADD`s ill-typed. It is not a completed word.

No non-member field has an odd singleton pairing at any cut. Across published exits into occupied compatible banks, 2650155 span-admitted pairings keep boundary rank 0. An off-route move of field 208 from frame 622 into frame 509 raises boundary rank from 0 to 1, and that edge is not in the route table.

## Task and overlap

Base commit: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` on canonical `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` main. Priority revision 8. Catalogue card `bit-helper-contract`. Scope status: **refined**.

The card asks whether a changed G20 path improves the complete BIT moment. This package does not build a new word. It answers the paid frame-conversion question left by Nick Petalas's free-carrier certificate on the same PR #5708 word.

Session r78, item 1 of the ordered eligible list. The 19 October handoffs are closed. Later handoffs whose artifact is an open pull request, including the H25 requests and the PR #6353/#6361 chain, are excluded. The remaining list is the revision-8 first-mention open questions of #5679, #5708, #5718, #5615, and #5717, after dropping delivered items:

1. This package. #5679's different physical role. The common-frame part is already certified. The paid conversion and its inverse were open.
2. #5679: another paid-query removal on the changed split word.
3. #5679: a stronger Gaussian caller for that BIT component.
4. #5708: a noncoordinate public input contract.
5. #5718: other legal boundary pairs.
6. #5718: one retained framework assumption.
7. #5615: a current source cut under the full dyadic criterion.
8. #5717: rebind the explicit-inventory audit to a changed ABI.
9. #5717: compiler, precision, storage and analytic premises.
10. #5713: whether the emitted artifact matches the credited edit.

Nearest work: Ali Romman's PR #5708 supplies the word and routes. Nick Petalas's free-carrier package shows that every common-frame bank has boundary rank 0 and leaves paid frame changes open. `research/g20-moved-correction-frame` moves one A2 correction; it does not decide this carrier round trip.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B research/g20-frame-round-trip-gap/verify.py
python3 -O -B research/g20-frame-round-trip-gap/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-frame-round-trip-gap
```

Observed `PASS_G20_FRAME_ROUND_TRIP_GAP` in both modes and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The registered replay also passed normal and optimized isolated runs. `python3 -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py` printed `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`.

Not run: member exits into occupied banks, a rewritten frame-517 schedule, Lean, Docker, and the selected cold replay.

## Credit

The word, the routes, and the open role question are Ali Romman's PR #5679 and PR #5708. The common-frame obstruction and cut algebra are Nick Petalas's. Gaussian elimination and rank-nullity are classical.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance.

## Open next questions

- Can a published exit of a group member into an occupied compatible bank raise the boundary rank? The non-member census does not answer it.
- Can the six frame-1 `ADD`s of helper 222 be retargeted onto frame 517 with a finite route and restoration bill? The singleton pairing is not that word.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The free-carrier handoff named one conversion and its inverse directly, which made the route-table check a finite census. A link to discussion #1200 is enough; no separate session report.
